verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.together.ai (HTTP 200). Docs pages are served as .md with an embedded pointer to the llms.txt index. Together also offers agent-oriented resources: a docs MCP server for live lookup, agent skills, and an OpenAPI spec listed in llms.txt. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs effectively, and no llms-full.txt evidenced.
